description: Persistent GPU task queue for the TripoSR-on-Kaggle prototype. This file is the resumable state: never lose progress, never generate twice for the same task, never hardcode a guaranteed quota.

policy.idempotency: A task with a completed job_id + output hash in history is never re-dispatched.
policy.quota: If Kaggle GPU/quota is unavailable, the task becomes DEFERRED_QUOTA (not failed) and is retried on a later allowed run.
policy.batch_size: 1-2 tasks per dispatch (master prompt §10: small reviewable batches).
policy.inputs: Only original or appropriately licensed images; each input image must have provenance recorded in assets/manifest.csv before a real run.
policy.outputs: Raw meshes are cleaned/exported by Blender headless in GitHub Actions BEFORE any catalog registration; TripoSR output alone is never a final asset.
policy.no_weights_in_repo: Model weights and datasets are never committed to this repository.

tasks.name: Pilot: single static object (canon-neutral prop)
tasks.purpose: End-to-end proof of the GPU lane (dispatch -> kernel -> retrieval -> Blender cleanup -> validation) with one static object that creates no canon conflict.
tasks.input_image_provenance: PLACEHOLDER: original or CC0 image to be added by the owner/agent before the first real run; record it in assets/manifest.csv first.
